description: Registry of Swiss open-data portals that run on Opendatasoft and can be searched/queried with search_portal_datasets, get_portal_dataset and query_portal_records: SBB (data.sbb.ch: station passenger frequency, rolling stock, actual train times), Basel-Stadt (real-time parking, Rhine temperature, air quality, elections), Basel-Landschaft, Canton & City of St. Gallen, Graubünden, Thurgau. Returns id, name, operator, domain, licence note, platform confidence and what each portal is good for.
name: list_data_portals
title: List Swiss Opendatasoft data portals
